title: ChronOps snapshot for Ajour, version 1
description: What MineHunter's GET /integration/ajour/snapshot returns to the chronops plugin: the caller's projects, their budget and their tasks, as ChronOps sees them. A change to this shape bumps version.

reportAt.description: The moment the budget figures are computed for, the end of the last ChronOps report.

workerLinked.description: Whether the token's user is linked to a ChronOps worker. Without the link, assignedToMe and myHours cannot be known.

code.description: The ChronOps project code, stable across renames.

complete.description: Whether ChronOps marks the project complete.

tasks.description: Every task of the project, including the ones not assigned to the caller.

mode.description: The period the cap and the consumed figures cover.

maxBudget.description: Money allowed for the period, when ChronOps knows it.

consumedHours.description: Hours consumed in the period, at reportAt.

spentBudget.description: Money spent in the period, at reportAt, when ChronOps knows it.

remainingHours.description: capHours minus consumedHours, negative when over.

status.description: ChronOps' own health colour. Unconfigured when the project has no budget set.

assignedToMe.description: False for every task when me.workerLinked is false.

myHours.description: The caller's hours on the task, null when not assigned or not linked.
